name: What is structural optimization using generative AI?

mainEntity.name: What is structural optimization using generative AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI evaluates thousands of beam, column, and foundation configurations under load conditions to create lighter, stronger structures that use less material while meeting seismic and wind requirements. tribe+1
